note: Fixed before any model run. Reps are outermost (1..conditions.json runs). Within a rep the entries of perRep run in this order; an entry <cell>:<case> of a negative case runs only in reps 1..negativeRuns. The cells are grouped by prompt level and fixture with the three tools levels next to each other, so a cap stop leaves the tools levels of a group at most one trial apart; the negative trials are interleaved, never adjacent and never last. harness/run-all.mjs runs only this order; run-trial.mjs refuses a planned trial that is not the next unreserved one and a replacement before every planned trial is reserved.
